title: Montagu advocates smallpox inoculation
summary: Lady Mary Wortley Montagu promoted smallpox inoculation in Britain in 1721 after encountering the practice in the Ottoman world. Knowledge crossed social and geographical boundaries.

claims.text: Lady Mary Wortley Montagu promoted smallpox inoculation in Britain in 1721 after encountering the practice in the Ottoman world. Knowledge crossed social and geographical boundaries.
This was variolation, using smallpox material, rather than Jenner’s later cowpox-based vaccination. The distinction matters when tracing medical practices.
